summary: Asteroids entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Asteroids
entries.definitive_edition: Original arcade Asteroids; Atari 50 arcade emulation for practical archive access

emulation.emulator: Atari 50 official emulation or MAME with verified ROMs
emulation.notes: Original cabinet remains the gold standard. Record emulator/collection version and input/display settings.

primary.version: Original arcade Asteroids, preferably via Atari 50 for practical access
primary.why: Asteroids is a 1979 Atari arcade vector shooter. The original arcade cabinet is the fidelity baseline, while Atari 50 is a current official collection that includes the arcade Asteroids route and related Atari historical material.
primary.how_to_play: Prefer original arcade hardware for exact controls/display. For practical archive play, use Atari 50 and record platform, input device, display/vector filter settings, game version, high-score settings, and whether Asteroids Deluxe/Recharged are compared separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Asteroids Deluxe or Asteroids: Recharged into the original entry; document display/vector filtering and input setup.
